blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), one of the leading real estate companies in the country, received numerous recognitions at the recently concluded 5th Annual PropertyGuru Philippines Property Awards 2017 held Thursday evening at the Fairmont Makati. At the Awards Gala night presented by Kohler, RLC bagged several prestigious awards including Best Retail Development for Robinsons Galleria Cebu and Best Residential Interior Design for the Sapphire Bloc. RLC’s The Radiance Manila Bay was highly commended for its architectural design. RLC was also given Special Recognitions in Corporate Social Responsibility and Sustainable Development which recognized the sustainable initiatives of outstanding developers from the country. Robinsons Land President, Mr. Frederick D. Go, was the highlight of the evening as he received the Real Estate Personality of the Year award for his contributions in the industry. The Philippines Property Awards is the biggest and most credible industry awards recognizing the best developers, projects and designs in the country.
